external_collaboration.evidence_quote: We would like to imagine one day they would get to know that their activism in form of a song has started little fires in a small region in the Southwest of Poland, and beyond. Their dream has inspired us to inspire young people. And now, almost 3 years after the 1st day, People Have the Power has travelled Poland, France, Spain, Denmark, Italy, Portugal, Croatia, Hungary, Georgia, Germany and Kosovo, and so many others who came in contact with us!
